# The cold rain {#project-rain-temp}

In this project, you will use weather data to explore a question of your choice.
Here is an example question that you may certainly use:

> What is the relationship between temperature and precipitation?

You could start this by creating a claim. 
Where I live, a good first claim might be:

> It's colder when it rains. 

## Weather data

You can get weather data from the NOAA plugin.
Go to the **Plugins** menu, then **Getting Data**, 
then **NOAA Weather**.
Figure out how to get data, get some, and start exploring.
It is colder when it rains? 
Is there some other obvious, simple claim you can address?

## Example start

For me, I got one year of data from San Francisco airport.
I made a new attribute called `anyPrecip` (calculating!) 
with this formula:^[Notice the cool syntax with the trinary `?-and-:` operator; it's an alternative to `IF()`.]

`precip > 0 ? "wet" : "dry"`

and plotted that against the high temperature:

![](art/projects-rain-temp-SFO-simple.png)

And as you can see, it *is* colder when it rains. 

Are we done?
Of course not. 
It's too simplistic.
See if you can figure out why. 

## Your task

You will get different data, of course, and analyze it,
assessing your own claim or answering your own question.
Then, did deeper, of course.
Add nuance.
Be a devil's advocate.

### Alternative data

You could get data from somewhere else, of course.
[Here is another source](https://codap.concord.org/releases/latest/static/dg/en/cert/index.html?di=https://codap.xyz/plugins/worldWeather/){target="_blank"} with cities in other countries.
